theme: Young investor / first-timer: starting early, small amounts, ₹500/month
headline: Start Your Investment Journey with Just ₹500
body: Beginning early with small amounts helps build wealth through consistency. Every rupee invested today compounds over time, creating long-term growth potential.
caption: Young investors can begin their wealth-building journey with minimal amounts. Starting early gives time for compounding to work in your favour. Regular, disciplined investing habits matter more than investment size. #StartEarly #SmallStepsGrowWealth #CompoundingPower #YoungInvestor #ConsistencyMatters
